name: Airbus H135 / EC135
summary: Light twin-engine helicopter with a Fenestron tail and rear clamshell doors, one of the most common air-ambulance and police helicopters in the US.

wings: Four-blade bearingless main rotor with a compact, low hub
engines: Two engines side by side on the roof behind the mast
Two exhausts at the rear of the cowling
fuselage: Compact rounded cabin with large curved windscreen
Rear clamshell doors under a high-mounted tail boom for stretcher loading
tail: Shrouded Fenestron tail rotor in the fin
Horizontal stabilizer with prominent endplate fins

tellTales: Small twin with four blades and a shrouded fan in the tail
Clamshell doors under a high-mounted tail boom
Endplate fins on the horizontal stabilizer

confusedWith.howToTell: The H145 is noticeably bigger with a taller, boxier cabin and high skids; the H135 is smaller and sits low, and the older EC145 has an open tail rotor.
The H130 has three blades and a single engine; the H135 has four blades and two engines.
The 429 has an open four-blade tail rotor; the H135 has a shrouded Fenestron.

usCount.source: FAA registry make/model inquiry (EC135 / H135 all variants)
